repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-scheduler
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin scaffold registered as webex.internal.scheduler. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-encryption and registers the Scheduler plugin with a placeholder config under the scheduler key and three example payload predicates and transforms; webex-core tests the predicates in each webex.transform call of webex instances built after the import. Scheduler has no scheduling behavior; its methods (exampleRequestUsage, exampleEventUsage, exampleMercuryConnection) are examples.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-scheduler package barrel
public_interfaces.audience: no workspace package; any application that imports the package
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-encryption for its side effect and registers Scheduler as internal plugin 'scheduler' with a placeholder config and three example payload predicates and transforms. config and CONSTANTS are not re-exported by the barrel.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.scheduler example methods
public_interfaces.notes: Examples only. exampleEventUsage throws; exampleRequestUsage and exampleMercuryConnection drop a promise without handling its rejection. See src/docs/README.md.

public_interfaces.name: payload predicates and transforms
public_interfaces.notes: Predicates are tested on webex.transform calls of webex instances built after the import, for the call's direction. A match rejects with a TypeError (outbound) or starts an unbounded chain that starves the event loop (inbound); see INV-002, INV-003, and Caller-visible failure modes in src/docs/README.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call the example methods from product code.
negative_guidance.why: exampleEventUsage throws, and the other two drop promises whose rejections are unhandled.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send payloads with value, inboundValue, or outboundValue fields through webex.transform while this package is imported.
negative_guidance.why: The example predicates match them; the outbound transform rejects with a TypeError and the inbound chain never settles and blocks timers and I/O.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not describe the package as implementing scheduling.
negative_guidance.why: No scheduling method exists; the README line describes intent only. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage gate applies: jest-config-legacy sets collectCoverage false and package.json has no coverage script.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, for example that request and logger are mounted.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example the example methods, initialize, the config, and the transforms. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question, for example what scheduler behavior the package should eventually provide. Stop and report the gap.
